The task: Move the info from the coastal correlation meetings in Nanaimo to tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class. 
1.) Pull the latest version of tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class into R.
2.) Update it using the spreadsheets updated during the Nanaimo meeting (in the External_ Coastal BEC Guide - Associations_Alliances_Review folder).
3.) Export it back into Access as an update table. 
4.) Make a copy of tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class  to avoid overwriting it, name it something e.g., Archived_
5.) Make another copy but copy over the structure only. 
6.) Append imported data from R into this blank version. 

Source files, load packages: 

Do some data checks before merging:  
```{r}
# Check for duplicates in SiteUnit in BEC.hier: 
BEC_hier_duplicates <- BEC.hier %>%
  add_count(SiteUnit, name = "Occurrences") %>%
  filter(Occurrences > 1) %>%
  arrange(SiteUnit)

# View results
BEC_hier_duplicates

# Make function that checks for duplicates and makes sure that all SiteUnits in each of the bec.tables are in the tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class table. 
check_site_units <- function(df, table_name) {
  
  tibble(
    Table = table_name,
    Rows = nrow(df),
    Unique_site_units = n_distinct(df$SiteUnit, na.rm = TRUE),
    Missing_site_units = sum(is.na(df$SiteUnit) | trimws(df$SiteUnit) == ""),
    Duplicate_site_units = sum(duplicated(df$SiteUnit[!is.na(df$SiteUnit)])),
    Not_in_bec_hier = nrow(
      df %>%
        filter(!is.na(SiteUnit)) %>%
        distinct(SiteUnit) %>%
        anti_join(
          BEC.hier %>% distinct(SiteUnit),
          by = "SiteUnit"
        )
    )
  )
}

# Run the function: 
site_unit_check <- imap_dfr(
  bec.tables,
  check_site_units
)

# Check results: 
site_unit_check

# Function to find missing or duplicated site units (if there are any): 
check_site_unit_issues <- function(df) {
  
  # Find site units missing from BEC.hier
  missing <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(SiteUnit)) %>%
    distinct(SiteUnit) %>%
    anti_join(
      BEC.hier %>% distinct(SiteUnit),
      by = "SiteUnit"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      Issue = "Missing from BEC.hier",
      SiteUnit,
      Occurrences = NA_integer_
    )
  
  # Find duplicated site units within the BEC tables (spreadsheets from meeting)
  duplicates <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(SiteUnit)) %>%
    add_count(SiteUnit, name = "Occurrences") %>%
    filter(Occurrences > 1) %>%
    transmute(
      Issue = "Duplicated",
      SiteUnit,
      Occurrences
    )
  
  # Combine results
  bind_rows(missing, duplicates)
}

# Run it: 
site_unit_issues <- imap(
  bec.tables,
  ~ check_site_unit_issues(.x)
)

# Combine: 
site_unit_issues_all <- imap_dfr(
  site_unit_issues,
  ~ mutate(.x, Table = .y)
) %>%
  select(Table, Issue, SiteUnit, Occurrences)

# Look at results: 
site_unit_issues_all

# Check the column names: 
column_check <- imap_dfr(
  bec.tables,
  ~ tibble(
    Table = .y,
    Column = names(.x),
    In_BEC_hier = names(.x) %in% names(BEC.hier)
  )
)

# Show only columns that don't match
column_differences <- column_check %>%
  filter(!In_BEC_hier)

View(column_differences)

# Check which columns are consistant: 
bec_columns <- names(BEC.hier)

# Columns in every meeting spreadsheet
bec.table_columns <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  lapply(bec.tables, names)
)

# Columns shared by everything
common_columns <- intersect(bec_columns, bec.table_columns)

# These are all the columns that will transfer without problems: 
common_columns

```

Update tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class with the Nanaimo meeting data: 
```{r}
BEC.hier_test <- BEC.hier

update_BEC.hier <- function(master, update_data, table_name,
                            na_action = "keep") {
  
  # Check SiteUnit values
  if (any(is.na(update_data$SiteUnit) |
          trimws(update_data$SiteUnit) == "")) {
    stop(table_name, ": missing or blank SiteUnit values.")
  }
  
  # Check duplicates in the meeting spreadsheet
  if (anyDuplicated(update_data$SiteUnit)) {
    stop(table_name, ": duplicated SiteUnits in meeting spreadsheet.")
  }
  
  # Check that all meeting SiteUnits exist in the master
  missing <- setdiff(update_data$SiteUnit, master$SiteUnit)
  
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(table_name, ": SiteUnits not found in BEC.hier: ",
         paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # Check that each SiteUnit identifies exactly one master row
  master_counts <- master %>%
    filter(SiteUnit %in% update_data$SiteUnit) %>%
    count(SiteUnit)
  
  duplicated_master <- master_counts %>%
    filter(n > 1)
  
  if (nrow(duplicated_master) > 0) {
    stop(table_name, ": SiteUnits match multiple rows in BEC.hier: ",
         paste(duplicated_master$SiteUnit, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # Add any new columns to the master
  new_columns <- setdiff(names(update_data), names(master))
  
  for (col in new_columns) {
    master[[col]] <- NA
  }
  
  # Identify columns to update (everything except SiteUnit)
  update_cols <- setdiff(names(update_data), "SiteUnit")
  
  # Match meeting records to master rows
  idx <- match(update_data$SiteUnit, master$SiteUnit)

  # Update the relevant columns
  for (col in update_cols) {
  
    new_values <- vctrs::vec_cast(
      update_data[[col]],
      master[[col]]
    )
    
    if (na_action == "keep") {
      # Only update cells with a non-NA value
      has_value <- !is.na(new_values)
      master[[col]][idx[has_value]] <- new_values[has_value]
    
    } else if (na_action == "overwrite") {
      # Update even when the meeting spreadsheet contains NA
      master[[col]][idx] <- new_values
    
    } else {
      stop("na_action must be 'keep' or 'overwrite'.")
      }
  }
  
  message(table_name, ": updated ", length(idx),
          " records across ", length(update_cols), " columns.")

  master
}

# Test: 
BEC.hier_test <- update_BEC.hier(
  master = BEC.hier_test,
  update_data = CWH_102,
  table_name = "CWH_102",
  na_action = "keep"
  )

```
